note: World spaces and coordinates (roadmap item 41; core/game/game_spaces.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). Every place the game has is a space with an id of its own and a position, so the text game's map and the sandbox name places the same way. Ids are paths: `world` is the open world (the generated surface and the ground under it); a town or a stretch of wilds is an AREA of it, `world/hearthmere`, a region round the place's anchor tile that is walked into; a dungeon is an INTERIOR, `world/goblin_warrens`, a space of its own entered through a door on the open world; a town's services are interiors of the town, `world/hearthmere/forge`, each with its door a few tiles from the town's centre (`service_doors`, as [east, south] of it, inside the town's cleared ground); and the family house is an interior of the home town (`house`). `kind_of_type` says which kind each place type in world.json is. Nothing here is saved or random: a space is worked out from world.json, this file and GameWorldGen's anchors.
